'''Dannik Jerriko''' is a [[persona]]: every card that represents this character counts as the same character, whatever its title, and each player may have only one card of a persona on the table at a time.<ref name="ar2023">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf Players Committee Advanced Rulebook] (2023), Chapter 5, Personas, and Appendix D, Persona Lists. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192915/https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> Cards and dated image publications of the Dannik Jerriko persona are listed below, with Decipher printings before the Players Committee's Virtual cards.

== Dated PC image publications ==
The June 2017 partial is used with the original physical card under the source cover instructions. Its inherited upper fields and printed lower slip are documented at [[Dannik Jerriko (PC Errata)]]. Full PC faces follow at [[Dannik Jerriko (PC Errata 2)]] and [[Dannik Jerriko (PC Errata 3)]]. These are image publications of the same persona.<ref name="pc-2017-images">[[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf|Players Committee Decipher Errata]], cover and PDF page 3; original upper face [[:File:ANH-D-dannikjerriko-decipher-archive.gif]].</ref>
